CORE MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 60
   B. 30
   C. 38
   D. 19

2. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 7
   C. 8
   D. 24.5

3. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 37
   C. 1
   D. 1

4. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 33
   C. 27.6
   D. 27.7

5. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 31

6. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.7
   C. 25
   D. 19.6

7. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15.7
   C. 21
   D. 15

8. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 2/2
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/4

9. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 100 m²

10. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 6x + 2

11. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 16
   C. 8
   D. 5

12. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 43
   D. 2

13. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

14. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 44
   C. 30
   D. 22

15. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 23
   C. 23.6
   D. 29

16. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 6
   B. 2, 4, 6
   C. 3, 6, 9
   D. 1, 2, 3, 6

17. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. Cannot tell

18. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 45
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 30

19. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

20. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 33
   C. 22
   D. 28

21. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31.7
   C. 37
   D. 31

22. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 25

23. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 170
   C. 13
   D. 26

24. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 36

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
